script_text:
This week, Taurus, money talks become relationship tests as Mercury opposes Uranus while Venus trines Saturn.

For Taurus rising, your earth-sign ruler Venus trines Saturn in the 9th House, so Tuesday rewards serious, honest relationship discussions and disciplined money decisions at work.

Wednesday turns tactical: Mercury nears opposition to Uranus in the 8th House, exposing hidden costs and last-minute changes in shared finances.

Thursday’s Sun approaches a trine to Jupiter in the 7th, supporting a promotion discussion or a better deal. By Saturday, the full Moon in your 7th brings a major relationship decision sharply into focus.

Thursday is your power day because the Sun trines Jupiter in the 7th House.

Saturday is your caution day because Mercury nears opposition to Uranus in the 8th House.

Put every joint expense and relationship expectation in writing before making any major financial moves.

Follow for daily updates.
